description: Flying replica of a Bristol Tourer built in Queensland for the 1985 television mini-series A Thousand Skies about Charles Kingsford Smith. Crashed near Geraldton on 1 June 1992 and rebuilt to static display standard; hangs from the ceiling of the museum painted as G-AUDK.
aliases: F2B; Bristol Tourer; G-AUDK; c/n QA-32-1
